definitions.usage: changeable suit of apparel, change of raiment.
definitions.full: H4254. machalatsah [ מַחֲלָצָה ] noun feminine robe of state ( taken off in ordinary life); — only plural absolute מַחֲלָצוֺת Isa 3:22 robes of ladies of Jerusalem; Zech 3:4 of high priest.
